title: A weekly aging report with reminder drafts: how it works
description:
What you send and what you get back in the four-week unpaid-invoice tracking pilot, for small service businesses that watch their cash flow.

Unpaid Invoice Tracker with Draft Reminders: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#cashflow #invoices

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/unpaid-invoice-tracking?src=youtube&utm_campaign=unpaid-invoice-how-it-works
narration: Each week you send your open invoices export, your payment terms, and any disputed invoices.
You get an aging report, the invoices that need a reminder this week and why, and a draft for each, friendly first, firmer later.
Amber doesn't contact your customers, and there are no late fees or collections language.
Up to 200 open invoices, four weekly reports. The price and terms are on the page.
